name: PDFBookmarks
tagline: Add nested PDF bookmarks and clickable tables of contents locally
description: Inspect PDF outlines, render selected pages for a vision-capable agent, plan page mappings, and save a new PDF with verified destinations. This server uses local stdio. In Cline, append --root and your absolute PDF folder to the installed server arguments. On a cold npm download, set the server timeout to 45 seconds if needed.
